segments.contextAfter: `interpolationPhase`: Array of float numbers to indicate which intervals to insert a frame between the current and next frame. Array size indicates how many frames are needed to interpolate and needs to match destinationFrames size, where there is one interval for each destination frame. Float number values should be between 0 and 1, e.g. to insert one frame in the middle, a value of 0.5 can be used.
